about: B170c (P-464, P-470; design/xfa-reuse-analysis-2026-11-11.md §4.1 row c, §4.2 (7)): the XFA engine's descriptor of each form's own Validate (its Validate button, validated flag, first-missing-field variable, barcode container and clear button, as SOM paths from the form's root subform), keyed by the official file's SHA-256 (official-sources/ircc/manifest.json), so another edition never borrows one. Copied unchanged from the engine's own test files named in `source`. Forms are data: the adapter (engine/xfa/index.ts) holds no form number or box name. A form with no record here is answered 'reads' when the engine reads it (its own check cannot run without a descriptor), else 'not available' with the engine's reason.
